footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Hinge Health: includes $104M from preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 50.6% to $588M in 2025. Gross margin was 79.6%, versus 76.8% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $546M from $31.9M.
The net loss widened to $424M, or −$7.77 per share, from $11.9M. Operating cash flow was $171M and free cash flow $171M, versus $48.0M; Hinge Health returned $65.0M through buybacks.
sources: Hinge Health, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
